numeric_limit_policy: Before held-out evaluation, freeze 1.25 times calibration maxima plus 1e-7 for each attention mode, projection and query domain. Final AV-latent limits also retain hard ceilings of relative L2 0.1 and max absolute 1.0. Report failures as unqualified, independently of port parity and human quality review.
